verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management platform, and its agents act on boards, items and updates. Reviewing an agent's code changes with line-level comments from a mobile app is a code-host or coding-agent capability, so the story is a category error for this product. Linking GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items and @mentioning agents in updates are adjacent features, not line-level code review, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
